newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The U.S. chiefs of missions to five South Asian countries begins a two-day meeting in Dhaka on Saturday.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will leave for the United States on January 29 to attend the summit on micro credit beginning in Washington on February 2.

The three-day peace talks between the government and the Parbatya Chattagram Jana Sanghati Samity (PCJSS) begins in Dhaka on Saturday to find a sloution to the decades old insurgency problem in the Chittagong Hill Tracts.
Agitated farmers in northern district of Rajshahi on Friday put barricade on Dhaka-Rajshahi highway demanding smooth supply of fertiliser at fair price.
Former President H M Ershad said on Friday that his successor Begum Khaleda Zia's Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) had conspired to kill him.
A seven-member British trade delegation begins a three day visit to Bangladesh from Sunday.
The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has indicated that it would lend Bangladesh $625 million for 1998 and 1999.
Islami Bank Bangladesh Ltd tops the list of private sector banks in respect of profit and investment in 1996.
